review_scope: Assertion-level mapping only for function-family file-only ledger references in the named inventory. Prior primary-source/oracle/fault reviews are cited as provenance; this does not re-audit every operator or function dictionary field.

decisions.decision: A ledger file pointer is evidence only for its named assertions and consumer route; do not infer that shadings.rs tests sampled or stitching functions merely from the path.
decisions.basis: shadings.rs uses Type 2/Type 4 functions in shading consumers. Its ShadingType 3 examples are radial shading, not FunctionType 3; its nonlinear mesh sample uses FunctionType 2.

decisions.decision: Keep the 5000 stitching-function cap and 100-entry reference/device limits characterized as reader/resource choices; the normative minimum stack capacity is 100 and there is no normative Type 3 k maximum found in the reviewed source.

Treat sampled extent and raster-conformance corpus as useful source-derived tests but retain fixture limits: explicit xref construction is present, while the helpers do not explicitly assert Document::was_recovered; the two-input reference specialization and GPU skips are documented limits.
Do not restate B09/B10 as new findings; they already exist in current global findings and the mapped tests identify their relevant boundaries.
